what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 45128 Iranian refugees in Germany, 28.6% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany is the largest host of Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in several periods, most recently with Jaish al-Adl from 2023 to 2025.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025, and armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iran with the KDPI in 2016 and 2018.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest point, 51538 refugees, and the figure fell to a low in 2006.
It then rose again, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2004, 2017 to 2021 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
